title: Coordinate separation in an affine form
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, $a=(a_j)_{j=0}^{n-1}\in\mathbb R^n$, $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and $x,b\in\{0,1\}^n$ with $b$ here a Boolean value. Write $x_{i\leftarrow b}$ for $x$ with coordinate $i$ replaced by $b$, and encode a bit $u$ by $1$ if $u=0$ and $-1$ if $u=1$. Then $c+\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}a_j\sigma((x_{i\leftarrow b})_j)=\left(c+\sum_{j\ne i}a_j\sigma(x_j)\right)+a_i\sigma(b)$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $c\in\mathbb R$, $a\in\mathbb R^n$, $i\in[n]$, $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and $b\in\{0,1\}$. If $x_{i\leftarrow b}$ replaces bit $i$ by $b$, then $c+\sum_j a_j(-1)^{(x_{i\leftarrow b})_j}=(c+\sum_{j\ne i}a_j(-1)^{x_j})+a_i(-1)^b$.
